scope: K1-K4 serial, no simultaneous MI worker
rationale: Small 1976/1981-row continuous growth models, one R worker and one Mplus process. Prior 112-parameter TECH3 calibration observed about 204 MiB Mplus private bytes. Reserve at least 0.5 GiB physical; do not generalize this admission to MI or latent interactions.
prohibited: No termination of unrelated processes; no concurrent MI; no increase in model processors.
